unit_tests.scope: Independent area and scaling identities, closed feed/product/tails accounts, monetary inclusion, finite crews, exact rate limits, integrated ramp, bootstrap delivery, quantity caps, timestep sensitivity, source binding and committed reproduction.

full_make_check.scope: Construction study and the complete existing repository; maintenance follow-up has its own later checks.

editorial_reading.scope: Full report read by parent and bounded resource reviewer for accepted design, evidence state, conservation, price and clock boundaries. Parent corrected a rounded upper-cost range and removed an ambiguous qualification label after reviewer reading. Final read placed pressure, temperature and fixed-price material assumptions beside the quantities and clarified accessible tailings storage after future flooding.

not_performed: Full engineering design or empirical structural/protection qualification.
Selected-site geotechnical survey, heritage decision, resource or ecological reservation approval.
Validated mining, fabrication or construction rates; commissioned upstream supply or supplier quotations.
A construction finance and long-duration operation/replacement budget.
Exact architectural daylight/comfort, radiation and thermal verification.
